summary: The implementation successfully addresses all six requirements. Backend persistence for Love Challenges was added (REQ-2), frontend connected to backend (REQ-3), Spin the Love Wheel physics implemented with ease-out cubic easing and randomized offset (REQ-4), real-time polling added to Activities page (REQ-5), and visual feedback for next badge milestone added (REQ-6). Badge filtering logic (REQ-1) is implemented in StreakMilestoneBadges component showing only unlocked badges based on current streak.
